title: Smoky Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, slow-cooked stew with the rich flavors of lamb and Chinese spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the lamb and set aside.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, smoky paprika, and argentinian oregano.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb shoulder back into the pot.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2-3 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with scallions, if desired.
